The first to lose his footing is defeated.”}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|— ''Unsouled'', chapter 5}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Lindon Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Lindon, also known as Wei Shi Lindon or [[Wei Shi Lindon Arelius]], is a powerful [[sacred artist]] who originated from the [[Wei clan]] in [[Sacred Valley]]. Initially identified as an [[Unsouled]] with a [[wooden badge]] and no [[madra]], he eventually ascended through various ranks, progressing from [[Iron]] to [[Jade]], [[Lowgold]], and eventually reaching the status of a [[Sage]] and [[Lord]]. His power is fundamentally tied to [[hunger madra]], which he utilizes through his connection to the [[Void Icon]] and the [[Slumbering Wraith]]. He is also recognized as a practitioner of the [[Path of Black Flame]]. Throughout his journey, Lindon has held various roles and affiliations. He was a member of the [[Wei clan]], an adopted [[disciple]] of the [[Arelius family]], and a representative for the [[Akura clan]]. His expertise includes [[Soulsmithing]] and the use of specialized techniques like the [[Hollow Domain]]. Lindon has demonstrated significant leadership, managing the evacuation of his clan and overseeing citizens in [[Dreadnought City]]. He has engaged in high-level conflicts involving [[Dreadgods]], [[Monarchs]], and other powerful entities across diverse locations such as the [[Blackflame Empire]], the [[Seishen Kingdom]], and [[Threshold]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Wei Shi Lindon is a tall, broad-shouldered man with short black hair and a rough face. His eyes have undergone various transformations, appearing as solid black with red irises, blue crystals with white circles, or even black-and-white [[Dreadgod]] eyes. He is often seen wearing [[Skysworn armor]], white [[disciple]]'s clothes, or robes of black, white, and purple.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Lindon possesses an [[Iron|iron]] will and a stubbornness that allows him to push through [[advancement]] realms. He is driven by an unhealthy obsession with [[advancement]] and a desire to find his own way in the [[sacred arts]]. Despite his power, he can experience quiet panic and feels a deep sense of responsibility for the lives lost under his command.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Lindon is a member of the [[Wei clan]] and the [[Shi family]], and he is the brother of [[Kelsa]]. He is a [[disciple]] and apprentice to [[Eithan|Eithan Arelius]], whom he calls elder brother, and he has trained under [[Fisher Gesha]]. He is a companion and rival to [[Yerin]], and he maintains a contract with [[Orthos]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Lindon is a [[Soulsmith]] and a [[Sage]] who utilizes the [[Path of Twin Stars]] to maintain two cores. He wields various techniques including the [[Heart of Twin Stars]], the [[Burning Cloak]], and the [[Empty Palm]]. His mastery extends to the [[Path of Black Flame]] and the [[Authority|authority]] of the [[Void Icon]], allowing him to use the [[Hollow Domain]] and [[Consume]] energy from others.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Wei clan life}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Wei Shi Lindon is a member of the [[Wei clan]] and the family Shi.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c1">''Unsouled'', chapter 1</ref> As an [[Unsouled]] [[sacred artist]], he uses a [[Foundation technique]] learned in childhood to cycle his [[madra]], which appears as blue-[[white light]] moving through his body like veins.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c2">''Unsouled'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c6">''Unsouled'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c10">''Unsouled'', chapter 10</ref> He can activate [[scripts]] using his [[madra]] and even use them to draw in a [[Remnant]] so that the [[spirit]]'s own [[madra]] powers the [[Script|script]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c2" /> While searching for an ancestral fruit for his mother, Lindon suffered a broken arm and lightning in his stomach.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c3">''Unsouled'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c4">''Unsouled'', chapter 4</ref> Despite having failed the testing bowl seventeen times, he manages his duties such as feeding [[Elder Whisper]] with [[Jade|jade-scaled]] river carp twice daily.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c3" /> To manage his injury, he uses a pain-suppressing [[Script|script]] left by his mother and cycles his [[madra]] to restore stamina.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c3" /><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c4" /> After his arm was removed from its sling, Lindon redoubled his training to find his own way in the [[sacred arts]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c7">''Unsouled'', chapter 7</ref> His daily routine consists of training with [[Kelsa]] in the [[courtyard]] during the mornings, studying [[technique]] manuals in the archive during the afternoons, and [[cycling]] in the evenings.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c7" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Referred to as Wei Shi Lindon, the eight-year-old boy is a [[disciple]] of the [[Heaven’s Glory School|Heaven's Glory School]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c11" /><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c12">''Unsouled'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c20">''Unsouled'', chapter 20</ref> He carries a glass bead token containing a blue candle-flame and wears white [[disciple]]'s clothes.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c11" /><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c17">''Unsouled'', chapter 17</ref> Currently at the [[Foundation]] stage of [[advancement]], Lindon possesses [[pure madra]] but has not yet reached the [[Iron stage]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c13">''Unsouled'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c14">''Unsouled'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c19">''Unsouled'', chapter 19</ref> After winning a contest against [[Kazan Ma Deret]] through incapacitation, he utilized an [[ancestral orus fruit]] to activate both a [[White Fox boundary formation|White Fox boundary]] and a [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c15">''Unsouled'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c19" /> His equipment includes a wooden [[ward key]], [[boundary flags]], [[Suriel's warm marble]], and a [[halfsilver|halfsilver dagger]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c17" /><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c19" /> Lindon also maintains a personal [[Boundary formations|boundary formation]] made of purple banners.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c17" /> While asking [[Yerin]] if she can keep him alive, he employs the [[Heart of Twin Stars]] [[cycling technique]] to split his core into two dim, blue-white balls of light.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c18">''Unsouled'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c20" /> He uses this [[technique]] to direct [[madra]] into one core while keeping the other closed.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c20" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Lindon is a character with an injured back who has founded a [[Path]] by splitting his core into two fist-sized parts to follow the [[Path of Twin Stars]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c2">''Soulsmith'', chapter 2</ref> Having successfully advanced to the [[Copper stage]], he possesses a [[Copper]] [[spirit]] and [[madra]] that manifests as a dim blue-[[white light]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c2" /><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c3">''Soulsmith'', chapter 3</ref> Known to [[Yerin]] as Wei Shi Lindon, he is a member of his clan who possesses a [[parasite ring]] and can switch between his primary core and a weaker one.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c3" /><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c4">''Soulsmith'', chapter 4</ref> While traveling on a cloud with [[Yerin]], he carries a [[wooden badge]] etched with the symbol 'empty' and a transparent bead of [[Forged madra]] in his pocket.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c4" /><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c6">''Soulsmith'', chapter 6</ref> Despite having a broad frame and [[pure madra]], Lindon suffers from a [[madra]] deficiency and his [[madra]] is essentially all [[water]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c9">''Soulsmith'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c12">''Soulsmith'', chapter 12</ref> As a newly adopted Fisher who has been working for [[Fisher Gesha]] for almost two weeks, he is currently learning [[Forging]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c12" /><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c13">''Soulsmith'', chapter 13</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|While present in the mines, Lindon is held as a prisoner forced to operate [[mining equipment]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c13" /><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14">''Soulsmith'', chapter 14</ref> He refers to [[Eithan]] as elder brother and possesses a [[Path]] manual, though his [[madra]] flow is knotted due to him splitting his core as a defensive measure.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14" /> Blind and covered in bruises from a fight, Lindon suffers from a cracked rib and swollen, useless legs that have prevented him from walking for days.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c15">''Soulsmith'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c16">''Soulsmith'', chapter 16</ref> Using spare [[madra]] to Forge the [[Sylvan]], he utilizes a [[spider-construct]]'s claws to cut [[dead matter]] away from [[Remnant]] pieces like shimmering green limbs and bright blue shells to build his [[fortress]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c16" /> Armed with a cloth-wrapped [[Sandviper Remnant stinger|Sandviper stinger]], he works to advance his cores, which are both at the peak of the [[Copper stage]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c16" /> After forging [[scales]] to advance, he pushes venom into his muscles, skin, and bones, resulting in deafening screams during a transformation that successfully transitions him to the [[Iron stage]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c16" /><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c17">''Soulsmith'', chapter 17</ref> Despite this [[advancement]], [[Lindon's core]] is shattered.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c19">''Soulsmith'', chapter 19</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Soulsmith}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|As a [[Soulsmith]], Wei Shi Lindon is the subject of probabilistic calculations concerning his future.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c19" /> While there is a high probability that he will fill one of his cores with the [[Path of the Stellar Spear]], it is also highly probable that he will die after inflicting a severe wound on [[Jai Long]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c19" /> There is a low probability that he will fail to find a suitable [[Path]] for his [[Path of Twin Stars]] and face execution by the [[Jai clan]], though Lindon does devise a weapon specifically designed to counter [[Jai Long]]'s spear.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c19" /> Ultimately, Lindon dies from his wounds following a duel.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c19" /> He wears an [[Iron|iron]] badge around his neck and holds the spear of his ancestor, even as [[Eithan]] questions whether Lindon can keep up with his goal.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c20">''Soulsmith'', chapter 20</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">10</span></div>

{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|As a student of [[Fisher Gesha]], Lindon possesses a [[spirit]] and trains in the art of [[Soulsmithing]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c1">''Blackflame'', chapter 1</ref> Utilizing the [[Enforce]] [[technique]], he [[scripts]] his camp to protect against [[dreadbeasts]] and [[Remnants]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c1" /><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c2">''Blackflame'', chapter 2</ref> An [[Underlord]] of the [[Iron stage]], Lindon has successfully brought down the [[Sandvipers|Sandviper]] heir.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c3">''Blackflame'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c5">''Blackflame'', chapter 5</ref> He possesses a [[Bloodforged Iron body]] that heals his fatigue as he cycles his [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c5" /> Though he carries a warm [[glass marble]] in his pocket, Lindon's true nature is defined by his two cores, one [[Copper]] and one [[Iron]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c5" /><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c6">''Blackflame'', chapter 6</ref> The combined strength of these cores equals that of a normal [[Iron]] [[sacred artist]], but his [[Path of Twin Stars]] actually breaks one normal core into two half-sized cores filled with [[Iron]]-quality [[pure madra]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c6" /><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c7">''Blackflame'', chapter 7</ref> While practicing a [[cycling technique]] that makes him feel as though he is choking and dying, Lindon uses a short-bladed knife and carries a glass ball containing a steady blue flame.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c6" /><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c7" /> Having seen visions of the planet's greatest people, Lindon was raised believing that [[dragons]] were merely myths.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c7" /><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c8">''Blackflame'', chapter 8</ref> He is interested in the [[Path]] of the [[Broken Star]] and has encountered [[Elder Whisper]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c9">''Blackflame'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c10">''Blackflame'', chapter 10</ref> Even with his eyes shut, Lindon can feel the presence of [[Orthos]], one of whose cores is a ball of black flames shot through with red.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c10" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|After [[Eithan]] directed him toward a specific [[Path]], Lindon developed a black-and-red core and learned to use the [[Burning Cloak]] [[technique]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c11" /><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c12">''Blackflame'', chapter 12</ref> While training in a damp cave, Lindon utilized a [[cycling technique]] taught by [[Eithan]] and possessed a smoky gray crystal.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c14">''Blackflame'', chapter 14</ref> During the [[Enforcer Trial]], he employed the [[Burning Cloak]] [[technique]], which he can maintain for twenty minutes provided he is not cut.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c14" /> Lindon eventually cleared the [[Enforcer Trial]] with a path suitable for a heron to kill a lion, fueled by his [[Blackflame core]] and ready [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c14" /><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c15">''Blackflame'', chapter 15</ref> As an [[Iron]]-stage [[sword]] artist with a contract with [[Orthos]], Wei Shi Lindon knelt before the [[Ruler Trial]]'s tablet alongside [[Yerin]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c16">''Blackflame'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c17">''Blackflame'', chapter 17</ref> Now a [[Jade stage]] practitioner, he entered the [[Ruler Trial]] possessing [[Blackflame]] and [[Twin Stars]] [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c17" /><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c18">''Blackflame'', chapter 18</ref> While feeling the pain of venom working through [[Orthos]], his core flared with a dark, bloody light as he used a simple breathing [[technique]] to digest power.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c19">''Blackflame'', chapter 19</ref> After using a [[Striker technique]] that caused [[spirit]]-straining dizziness, he obtained a [[Jade|jade]] badge and found [[Eithan]] at the edge of a cliff.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c19" /><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c20">''Blackflame'', chapter 20</ref> Lindon's eyes resemble a [[death Remnant]], characterized by black surroundings and [[blood]]-red rings in the center.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c20" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Monarch's pocket world}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Lindon is driven by a desire to discover a method for catching [[Eithan]] in either an evasion or a lie.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c18" />}}

</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Lindon is a [[Gold stage]] Wei Shi who possesses the [[Eye of the Deep]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c2">''Ghostwater'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c3">''Ghostwater'', chapter 3</ref> After stepping through a [[portal]] into a bubble of air, his [[madra channels]] shrieked in protest from the effort of forcing out [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c3" /> Clad in a [[Burning Cloak]], he possesses an apprentice [[Soulsmith]] status and a skeletal [[Lindon's skeletal Remnant arm|Remnant arm]] made of [[white madra]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c4">''Ghostwater'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c6">''Ghostwater'', chapter 6</ref> Despite his core containing almost nothing and his [[pure core]] dying at a snail's pace without assistance, he compared an [[elixirs|elixir]] to a full night's sleep in a bottle.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c6" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c9">''Ghostwater'', chapter 9</ref> While [[Yerin]] mentions that he is alive, Lindon has struggled with an inhuman right hand that would not obey him as he grabbed an old [[Remnant]] body to run through the trees.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c7">''Ghostwater'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c8">''Ghostwater'', chapter 8</ref> He is able to consume [[madra]] and use techniques such as the [[Striker]], [[hunger binding]], and [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]], alongside his [[Flowing Flame madra]] and training from [[cycling]] the energy of the sacred fish.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c10">''Ghostwater'', chapter 10</ref> Wearing a [[gold badge]], Lindon observed blue lights and silver [[scales]] near a bubble while his [[madra channels]] were strengthened by [[water]] from the [[Spirit Well]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c10" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c11">''Ghostwater'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c12">''Ghostwater'', chapter 12</ref> By pushing the barriers of [[Lowgold]] due to the [[Spirit Well]], he reached [[Highgold]] on the [[Path of Black Flame]] in two days using a [[Twin Stars manual]] while located in the [[Monarch]]'s [[pocket world]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c13">''Ghostwater'', chapter 13</ref><ref {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Two weeks after reaching the [[Spirit Well]], Lindon advanced to [[Highgold]] in his [[pure core]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c15">''Ghostwater'', chapter 15</ref> As a [[Highgold]], he utilizes a [[void key]] for item storage and employs the [[Soul Cloak]] [[technique]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c15" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c16">''Ghostwater'', chapter 16</ref> While [[cycling]] [[fire and destruction aura]] from burning undergrowth and transferring power from the [[Life Well]] to [[Dross]], he uses [[Dream Well water]] to remain awake.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c15" /> After launching a bolt of [[dragon]]'s fire at [[Akura Harmony|Harmony]], he is noted to possess [[Suriel's glass bead|Suriel's marble]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c15" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c16" /> Approaching the [[Truegold]] stage, Lindon is a person [[Yerin]] desires to reach.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c16" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c17">''Ghostwater'', chapter 17</ref> His [[Goldsign]] has become more dense, and through his [[spiritual perception]], he can feel the armor draining [[Akura Harmony|Harmony]]'s [[spirit]] and attention.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c18">''Ghostwater'', chapter 18</ref> He also used his reinforced body and the [[Soul Cloak]] to climb a cliff.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c15" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c19">''Ghostwater'', chapter 19</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|While [[cycling]] [[madra]] to his limb to avoid being lost to the [[wind]], Lindon utilized [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]] in his left palm.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c2">''Underlord'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c3">''Underlord'', chapter 3</ref> His body had been enhanced by [[Ghostwater]] meat, and he used a nail to scratch runes into a door.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c3" /> Lindon considered pulling [[Dross]] out of his [[spirit]] while wearing a tight-fitting cloth suit beneath his armor.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c4">''Underlord'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5">''Underlord'', chapter 5</ref> Relying almost entirely on [[Blackflame]], he has practiced the [[Heaven and Earth Purification Wheel]] for a year and a half as he attempts to master [[Soulsmithing]] and two [[Paths]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5" /> Having found a way to enhance his mind, he possesses [[Ghostwater|ghostwater]] and a [[Life Well]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c7">''Underlord'', chapter 7</ref> His [[void key]] contains [[Harmony's axe]], though his [[soulspace]] is not yet large enough to hold it.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c7" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c11">''Underlord'', chapter 11</ref> With a low supply of [[Spirit Well water]], Lindon has used the liquid to push his [[pure core]] closer to [[Truegold]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8">''Underlord'', chapter 8</ref> His [[Blackflame core]] resembles a dark sun on one side of his [[spirit]], balanced by an equal blue-white core.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8" /> After reaching the end of [[Truegold]] and opening his [[soulspace]], Lindon sat in the [[Night Wheel Valley]] forest.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c9">''Underlord'', chapter 9</ref> He was not involved in the fighting detected by [[Yerin]]'s senses, yet a woman asked for Wei Shi Lindon.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c10">''Underlord'', chapter 10</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|As a [[Blackflame]] boy and apprentice to [[Eithan|Eithan Arelius]], Lindon is capable of gathering [[Blackflame]] into his hand and utilizing unshaped [[pure madra]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c11" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c12">''Underlord'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c13">''Underlord'', chapter 13</ref> While his lifeline remains healthy, he utilizes [[Harmony's axe]] and possesses a jagged, angular [[Remnant]] replacement for his hand.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c11" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c12" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c14">''Underlord'', chapter 14</ref> This white [[Lindon's skeletal Remnant arm|Remnant arm]] was created alongside [[Fisher Gesha]], whom [[Eithan]] led Lindon to find, and though it has been repaired with [[hunger binding|hunger bindings]] from [[dreadbeasts]], the limb is losing its luster and is expected to be lost upon his [[advancement]] to [[Underlord]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c14" /> A member of the [[Skysworn]] who uses [[dream madra]], Lindon finds his concentration enhanced by [[Dross]]'s presence.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c14" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c15">''Underlord'', chapter 15</ref> Though cut off from the [[Arelius family]], he carries a ball of [[gray soulfire]] within his [[spirit]] and is currently on the brink of becoming an [[Underlord]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c14" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c15" /> Clad in modified [[Skysworn armor]] that leaves his white [[Remnant]] limb bare, he can cycle [[Blackflame]] and uses a [[void key]] to pull out an axe.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c17">''Underlord'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c18">''Underlord'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20">''Underlord'', chapter 20</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Known as the [[Blackflame]], Lindon wields an axe featuring a red gleaming edge and a long bone haft.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20" /> As a [[Truegold]], he possesses a [[white arm]] capable of cracking to spray [[madra]], though his [[Remnant]] limb remains fractured and barely holding together.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20" /> He utilizes [[hunger binding]] in his arm and employs [[pure madra]] to bind [[Archstone]] fragments, while using [[Ghostwater|ghostwater]] to aid mental imaging during his forging processes.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20" /> Through a [[soulfire transformation]], his [[Lindon's skeletal Remnant arm|Remnant arm]] is repaired into a pure white human arm as the [[soulfire]] rebuilds his bones and [[madra channels]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c21">''Underlord'', chapter 21</ref> After advancing to the rank of [[Underlord]], he uses [[Underlord]] [[madra]] to activate a [[binding]] on his axe and gains the [[spiritual perception]] of a [[Lord]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c21" /> Despite his [[Skysworn armor]] being cracked all over, he is mentioned in relation to the [[tournament]] and is identified as [[Kelsa]]'s brother.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c21" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c22">''Underlord'', chapter 22</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Having trained at the [[Akura clan|Akura family]], Lindon wears their [[sacred artist's robe|sacred artist's robes]] and utilizes the [[Soul Cloak]] to move with /> With the help of [[Little Blue]] for his core, Lindon utilizes a [[Remnant hand]] to conduct the [[Empty Palm]] and employs [[hunger binding]] to weaken incoming attacks.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c14" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c15">''Uncrowned'', chapter 15</ref> After gathering [[pure madra]], Lindon's head was torn off by [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]]'s claws, though he later reappeared on the beach following the battle.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c15" /> Lindon can let the [[Path of Black Flame]] bleed into his eyes and wears a [[halfsilver badge]].<ref closely, the rival of [[Yerin]] used a shield that can take a spiritual form along with [[Wavedancer]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c19" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c20">''Uncrowned'', chapter 20</ref> Lindon uses [[soulfire]] control to weaken [[sword aura|sword-aura]] and employs a [[technique]] from [[Eithan]] to blast [[pure madra]] from his body as spiritual armor.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c20" /> Described as a [[madra]] monster, he tapped out his [[pure core]] after a massive [[madra]] attack and possesses the ability to Forge [[Blackflame madra]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c20" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Post-tournament in Akura Spire}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|After his [[madra]] was affected by a will not his own, Lindon was eliminated from the [[Uncrowned King Tournament|Uncrowned King tournament]] and did not see the [[Dragon King]] leave.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c2">''Wintersteel'', chapter 2</ref> While staying in a room within the [[Akura clan|Akura]] family's amethyst spire, which he accesses via a scripted card, Lindon was a [[Copper]] at the time of [[Judge Suriel|Suriel]]'s visit.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c3">''Wintersteel'', chapter 3</ref> While sitting cross-legged on his bed, he sensed [[blood madra]] within [[Yerin's spirit]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c3" /> A companion to [[Eithan]] and [[Yerin]], Lindon watched the fight from the [[Akura audience platform]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c4">''Wintersteel'', chapter 4</ref> He practices the [[Heaven and Earth Purification Wheel]] [[technique]] and possesses a [[Remnant hand]] with five white fingers.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c5">''Wintersteel'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c6">''Wintersteel'', chapter 6</ref> While watching the [[Uncrowned]] matches with [[Yerin]] and [[Mercy]], Lindon has been training as instructed by [[Northstrider]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c6" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7">''Wintersteel'', chapter 7</ref> Seeking enemies for training, he expressed interest in joining the [[Akura clan|Akura]] operation near the [[Wandering Titan]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7" /> Feeling embarrassment for being the only one who had not made it, he used a [[void key]] to open a closet-sized door in midair.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8">''Wintersteel'', chapter 8</ref> Following a match against [[Yerin]], Lindon summoned the [[Ninecloud Soul]], revealing that he has two spirits and is wearing a blue-white [[Soul Cloak]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c9">''Wintersteel'', chapter 9</ref> As he is prepared for battle against enemy [[Underlord|Underlords]], the [[Herald]] uses a [[pure madra]] [[veil]] and possesses [[The Dragon Descends|the Dragon Descends]] [[technique]], the [[Heart of Twin Stars]], [[Wavedancer]], and is working on a new [[technique]] called [[Hollow Domain]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c9" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c10">''Wintersteel'', chapter 10</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|While traveling on a green [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]], Lindon is accompanied by a blue [[spirit]] perched upon his shoulder.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c12" /> Driven by a fever for points, he works as a [[Soulsmith]] during times when missions are unavailable and utilizes [[Little Blue]] to treat his injuries.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c12" /> As the leader of his group, Lindon helped a team force [[Truegold]] cultists away from a tower after instructing [[Dross]] to relay his plan to [[Akura Pride|Pride]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c12" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c13">''Wintersteel'', chapter 13</ref> During the engagement, he used a [[gatestone]] resembling sparkling blue chalk and manipulated [[earth aura]] and [[madra]] to form blades from loose stones.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c13" /> He employed a combination of [[Ruler]] and [[Striker techniques]] to cause both physical and spiritual [[destruction]] while wearing prototype armor cobbled together from [[Skysworn]] pieces and scavenged [[Seishen Kingdom]] plates.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c13" /> This armor can activate six full-body [[Enforcer techniques]] simultaneously, though Lindon's [[pure madra]] empowered by [[Little Blue]] interferes with the device.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c13" /> After leaping forward in combat, Lindon failed to defeat his opponent under [[tournament]] conditions and was eventually eliminated from the matches.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c13" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c14">''Wintersteel'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c16">''Wintersteel'', chapter 16</ref> Despite his elimination, he remained crouched on a [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]] with an interest only in [[Yerin]] and a belief that [[Mercy]] and [[Min Shuei]] could win, though [[Charity]] noted he would no longer have time for his former activities.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c14" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c17">''Wintersteel'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c18">''Wintersteel'', chapter 18</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Conflict at the Wandering Titan}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|During a fight against [[Naian Blackflame]], Lindon utilized [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]] from his palm and projected a domineering, aggressive impression while holding [[Blackflame]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c18" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c19">''Wintersteel'', chapter 19</ref> While [[Yerin]] sat across from him at the [[Sundown Pavilion]], Lindon found himself in a dangerous situation where his safety relied on her victory.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c20">''Wintersteel'', chapter 20</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c21">''Wintersteel'', chapter 21</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c22">''Wintersteel'', chapter 22</ref> Riding a [[Black dragons|black dragon]], Lindon sought permission to drain [[madra]] from the [[Wandering Titan]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c23">''Wintersteel'', chapter 23</ref> After a period of rest where he performed no [[Soulsmithing]], Lindon checked his [[void key]] before being rendered unresponsive by a vision.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c24">''Wintersteel'', chapter 24</ref> He attempted to separate his own memories from those of the [[Dreadgod]] while standing amidst a circle of onlookers.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c24" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c25">''Wintersteel'', chapter 25</ref> [[Ruby]] spent three days with Lindon, though she believed he would hate her.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c25" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26">''Wintersteel'', chapter 26</ref> Mentioned in connection to [[Malice]]'s plans and having been protected by [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]], Lindon observed the battle involving [[Fury]] before moving to join the gang.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27">''Wintersteel'', chapter 27</ref> Using [[spiritual perception]] to sense his surroundings, Lindon cycled his [[madra]] to its limit and barreled into [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]], whom he had trained against six hundred and forty-four times.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27" /> While maintaining a [[pure madra]] field that made his eyes look like deep blue gems, Lindon revealed a white hand and demonstrated an [[Enforcer technique]] stronger than [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]]'s.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28">''Wintersteel'', chapter 28</ref> Lindon used a [[Forged palm]] of [[pure madra]] to wipe out [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]]'s [[spirit]], causing his eyes to transform into blue crystal as he declared himself the end while a black hole swallowed the sky above him.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Lindon is a [[Sage]] who shares a personal [[cloud fortress]] with [[Yerin]], whom he is accompanied by.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c2">''Bloodline'', chapter 2</ref> A star of the [[Uncrowned King Tournament|Uncrowned King tournament]], he possesses perception better-trained than the average [[Underlord]] and can sense things [[Yerin]] cannot.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c3">''Bloodline'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c4">''Bloodline'', chapter 4</ref> Using his [[Remnant hand]] to drain souls by tightening his grip, he can also feel distortions in space and activated a [[script-circle]] to lift protections.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c4" /> Feeling responsible for the lost lives of the [[Akura Golds]], Lindon maintains a [[fortress]] that uses security circles to disperse hostile [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c4" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c5">''Bloodline'', chapter 5</ref> Despite being a character who prefers to keep a low profile, he landed on a snowy mountainside near [[Mount Samara]] while wearing a [[wintersteel badge]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c5" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c6">''Bloodline'', chapter 6</ref> After absorbing a [[Striker technique]] into his [[hunger arm]] and choosing not to use the [[Burning Cloak]] to close distances, he inquired about the [[Wei clan]] exiles.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c6" /> He is a tall individual with red-and-black eyes, a pale right hand, and wears robes of black, white, and purple with a [[shadesilk ribbon]] holding an [[Unsouled symbol]] badge.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c7">''Bloodline'', chapter 7</ref> While he gripped the [[Enforcer]] by the neck, it was noted that he is a [[Lord]] at a realm beyond [[Gold]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c7" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c8">''Bloodline'', chapter 8</ref> Currently at the [[Lowgold]] level with the spiritual strength of a [[Truegold]], his eyes are made of blue crystal with white circles for irises.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c9">''Bloodline'', chapter 9</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Void Sage authority}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Possessing the [[Authority|authority]] of the [[Void Sage]], Lindon is a swordsman who utilizes [[White Fox|White Fox madra]] and can employ the [[Consume]], [[Forger]], and [[Fox Mirror]] techniques.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c12" /> During combat, he used the [[Empty Palm]] [[technique]] on the Third Elder and utilized his [[Hollow Domain]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c15">''Bloodline'', chapter 15</ref> Lindon maintains a [[fortress]] that he accesses by using [[madra]] to open the door, and he once activated a [[viewing construct]] to observe the scene behind him.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c15" /> While his [[madra]] can become disordered, he is able to change his eyes to blue by flowing [[pure madra]] through himself.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c16">''Bloodline'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c17">''Bloodline'', chapter 17</ref> After his childhood home was destroyed, Lindon stopped a cloud's propulsion when his [[spirit]] screamed a warning.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c17" /> By manifesting an [[Icon]] and brushing against [[Way|the Way]], Lindon advanced to the Overlord stage, a feat that led [[Jai Long]] to perceive him as a [[Sage of Twin Stars]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c18">''Bloodline'', chapter 18</ref> His future self is seen with eyes like black pools containing white circles and arms consisting of one white limb and one coated in black [[scales]], possessing the ability to forge a weapon with the power of a [[Dreadgod]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c18" /> After returning functional [[constructs]] to his [[void key]], Lindon rose on his cloud near the halo of light around [[Mount Samara]] and pulled [[Yerin]] onto the cloud by her arm.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c18" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c19">''Bloodline'', chapter 19</ref> As [[madra]] streamed from [[Yerin]] and [[Eithan]], Lindon's vision blanked out, forcing him to use his [[Soul Cloak]] to stay standing while he opened his [[void key]] and prepared to hit the [[Titan]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c19" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Transcendent Ruins}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|A few years ago, Lindon established an alliance of five factions following the emergence of the [[Transcendent Ruins]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c4">''Reaper'', chapter 4</ref> He emits pure blue-[[white madra]] and possesses the ability to command the Book to release [[Mercy]], an entity he wishes to study.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c4" /> Driven by an unhealthy obsession with [[advancement]], the twenty-year-old [[Sage]] has reached the Overlord stage.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c4" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c5">''Reaper'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c6">''Reaper'', chapter 6</ref> Having summoned the [[Void Icon]] while he was an [[Underlord]], Lindon has also taught students a spiritual [[Enforcer technique]] known as the [[Heart of Twin Stars]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c5" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c7">''Reaper'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c8">''Reaper'', chapter 8</ref> His right arm consists of [[hunger madra]] stitched together from [[dreadbeasts|dreadbeast]] cores, and he sometimes seeks comfort from the warmth of [[Suriel's glass bead|Suriel's marble]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c8" /> Equipped with [[Soulsmithing]] tools, [[goldsteel-plated tongs]], a knife, and various supplies for refining, he uses [[spiritual perception]] to trace [[madra]] systems.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c12">''Reaper'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c13">''Reaper'', chapter 13</ref> While waiting outside a chamber filled with raging, deadly blades, he finds himself facing focused beams of heat and razor-sharp edges rather than the illusions or clouds he expected.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c12" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c13" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Lindon possesses the ability to sense [[void keys]] and can run his [[madra]] through them.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c13" /> Utilizing a [[Hollow Domain]] and three compatible [[madra]] types, he can dismantle the techniques of others, with his [[pure madra]] proving more effective at this task than [[destruction madra]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c14">''Reaper'', chapter 14</ref> His arsenal includes [[soulfire]] and [[black dragon's breath]], and he is a person known to [[Judge Suriel|Suriel]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c14" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c15">''Reaper'', chapter 15</ref> While enhanced by the [[Soul Cloak]], Lindon straps three [[launcher construct|launcher constructs]] to his left arm and has used a healing [[construct]] on [[Mercy]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c16">''Reaper'', chapter 16</ref> During a confrontation where he was surrounded by [[water]], Lindon switched to his [[Blackflame core]] and controlled finger-thin beams of [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17">''Reaper'', chapter 17</ref> Despite being low on [[madra]] and [[soulfire]], Lindon leveraged his [[Void authority]] to affect portals made from the [[Path]] of the [[Path of the King’s Key|King's Key]] and struck [[Reigan Shen]] through the gut with a [[Hollow Spear]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17" /> The battle left Lindon in a dire state, having lost an arm and possessing a broken, limp right hand while his [[pure core]] was mostly empty.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c18">''Reaper'', chapter 18</ref> While experiencing [[hunger aura]] and sensing something in [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]], he slumped against a panel appearing ready to collapse from shame and depression.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c18" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|After being remade by the [[Pure Storm Baptism]], Lindon gained the ability to focus his [[Authority|authority]] on the [[Dreadgod's hand]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c20" /> He wields the spear [[Midnight]] while possessing the [[Dawn Sky Palace]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c21">''Reaper'', chapter 21</ref> While Lindon may be capable of feeling alarm, he intends to tell a story and offers a salute to the [[Dreadgod]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c21" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c22">''Reaper'', chapter 22</ref> He is able to read the power of [[Reigan Shen]] and has strained his connection to [[Tiberian Arelius]]' space past its breaking point.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c23">''Reaper'', chapter 23</ref> Lindon swore an oath to ensure the safety and freedom of [[Reigan Shen]], utilizing [[soulfire]] within his [[Hollow Domain]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c23" /> Despite having a dead arm, he survived an axe attack using the [[Soul Cloak]] and blocked lightning with a shield summoned from his [[void key]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c23" /> He employed the [[Empty Palm]] [[technique]] against acidic liquid and used explosive single-use [[bombs]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c23" /> As the apprentice of one of [[Ozmanthus Arelius|Ozmanthus]]' last descendants, Lindon possesses the blessing of the [[Slumbering Wraith]]'s echo and saw his [[hunger arm]] crumble completely due to a new level of energy.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c23" /> While in a [[labyrinth]], his [[Void Icon]] resonated with the power of [[hunger]] and he gave his word to [[Subject One]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c23" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c25">''Reaper'', chapter 25</ref> Lindon now possesses a white-gray right arm that is more physical than ever, though it remains sealed.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c25" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c26">''Reaper'', chapter 26</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Resembling Ozriel, Lindon possesses an [[Iron|iron]] will and [[madra]] that is pure yet tinged with the [[hunger]] of [[Subject One]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c1">''Dreadgod'', chapter 1</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c2">''Dreadgod'', chapter 2</ref> He uses a scripted black strip of cloth to suppress his [[Lindon's skeletal Remnant arm|Remnant arm]], which is [[the hand]] of [[Subject One]] and capable of feeding on sensed power.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c2" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3">''Dreadgod'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c5">''Dreadgod'', chapter 5</ref> While he is expected to be in [[Everwood]], Lindon cannot yet ascend because the [[Dreadgods]] remain.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3" /> As he creates [[constructs]], including life and [[blood]] varieties to stimulate healing, Lindon has also engaged in conversation with [[Northstrider]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c4">''Dreadgod'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c5" /> Following an examination by [[Reigan Shen]] that found no immediate danger, Lindon advanced to the rank of [[Archlord]] and began consuming the power of weapons.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c4" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c5" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c8">''Dreadgod'', chapter 8</ref> After teaching [[Yerin]] a basic language [[construct]], Lindon began experiencing vivid nightmares following the rise of [[Dross]]'s current personality.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c9">''Dreadgod'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c10">''Dreadgod'', chapter 10</ref> Upon discovering the truth regarding [[Monarchs]] and [[Dreadgods]], Lindon absorbed the [[Diamond Veins]] but violated his oath to [[Malice]] by revealing this connection.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c11">''Dreadgod'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c12">''Dreadgod'', chapter 12</ref> A hulking young man whose [[white arm]] disturbs spiritual senses, Lindon was carried to [[Malice]] by [[Charity]] as a dead weight that weighed two and a half times her own mass.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c12" /> His body and [[spirit]] were recently wracked with pain, and his will may be compromised due to mental trauma.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c12" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Possessing the [[Authority|authority]] to manipulate empty spaces, Lindon realized that the [[Silent King]]'s assault extended beyond [[Moongrave]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c15" /> As the only student [[Kelsa]] has ever trained, she considers his [[Soulsmithing]] to be amazing.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c15" /> Lindon utilized his [[Hollow Domain]] to catch himself upon his [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]] while his muscles were suffused with life and [[blood essence]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c16">''Dreadgod'', chapter 16</ref> After presenting [[Yerin]] with a packaged set of fully balanced treasures, he left protections for [[Kelsa]] and instructed her to sleep inside scripted walls and use a specific device if she were besieged.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17">''Dreadgod'', chapter 17</ref> His mind-[[spirit]] was designed by [[Northstrider]], and Lindon eventually erupts in a globe of [[pure madra]] fueled by his [[white hunger madra]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18">''Dreadgod'', chapter 18</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Fighting the Silent King}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|While fighting the [[Silent King]], the young [[Void Sage]] Lindon utilized a [[spirit]] enhanced by energy stolen from the [[Dreadgod]], who had previously assaulted him.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18" /> Connected to [[Way|the Way]], Lindon consumed the [[Silent King]] to reclaim his missing memories and [[dream essence]], an act during which his arm burned with greed.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19">''Dreadgod'', chapter 19</ref> As his [[spirit]] reached its limit while swallowing the king's power, Lindon gathered his remaining energy into [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]], causing his [[madra channels]] to burn into his flesh and his cores to condense like a [[spirit]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19" /> With eyes that blazed and froze like they were channeling [[pure madra]] and [[Blackflame]], the boy arrived behind [[Yerin]] with two white Broken Crowns and white circles in his eyes.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19" /> After preparing emergency measures for [[Orthos]], Lindon shot [[Blackflame]] through the [[Dreadgod]]'s head and provided a [[void key]] to [[Orthos]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21">''Dreadgod'', chapter 21</ref> Though he lacks the skill to create a [[portal]] from [[Serpent's Grave|Serpent’s Grave]] to [[Sacred Valley]], Lindon can fly on an [[aura]] of [[wind]] and force, possesses a chalk-white palm, and holds the [[Remnant of the Blood Sage]] along with the [[Rune Queen's script]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21" /> Believing that reaching the peak of [[Archlord]] brings one close to [[Sage]], Lindon can use the [[Void Icon]] to hide himself and others, and his power as Wei Shi Lindon is capable of overcoming temporary [[aura]] circles.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c22">''Dreadgod'', chapter 22</ref> Feeling pride, Lindon used a hammer to shape his will within the [[Soulforge]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c22" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c23">''Dreadgod'', chapter 23</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Lindon possesses the physical strength of a [[Herald]] and utilizes a [[Full-body Enforcer technique|full-body Enforcer technique]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c23" /> In combat, he employs a [[flying sword]] and uses an open [[void key]] to summon various [[constructs]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c23" /> He can weaken [[Shadow|shadow]] blades through the use of his [[Hollow Domain]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c23" /> His temper is volatile enough to cause the [[Burning Cloak]] to burst involuntarily, though he can also release a [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]] empowered by the [[Void Icon]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c23" /> Additionally, Lindon possesses a cleansing tide of [[pure madra]] and picked up [[Mercy]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c23" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Lindon possesses a repurposed [[pocket world]] and utilizes the [[Void Icon]] to monitor spatial stability.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c2">''Waybound'', chapter signet [[ring]], an ancient [[Monarch]]'s scepter, and a robe once belonging to [[Northstrider]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c2" /> He guides his restorative [[aura]] with [[Suriel's glass bead|Suriel's marble]] and wears a crown that is the legacy of an ancient [[Monarch]] found within [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c2" /> While he can easily repair physical damage to a scepter, Lindon is also capable of effortlessly performing complex [[Ruler techniques]] despite lacking a compatible [[Path]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c2" /> As he prepares to embed illusion [[constructs]] into the chamber floors, Lindon completes the construction of [[Ghostwind Hall]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c2" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c3">''Waybound'', chapter 3</ref> Capable of consuming [[Remnants]], Lindon attempts to hide his frustration from [[Orthos]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c3" /> After stealing a [[pocket world]] core from [[Reigan Shen]], who desires for both Lindon and [[Yerin|Yerin Arelius]] to be gone, he uses [[goldsteel-plated tongs|goldsteel tongs]] to grip a [[binding]] that burns against his spiritual senses and eyes.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c4">''Waybound'', chapter 4</ref> Lindon carries a main [[void key]] around his neck and maintains a connection to the [[Void Icon]], which allows him to adjust the flow of time.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c5">''Waybound'', chapter 5</ref> Utilizing the [[Bow of the Silent King]], he can forge an arrow from the [[binding]] at its heart and use a [[Forger technique]] to release ten thousand identical arrows, allowing him to move himself to the location of an arrow.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c5" /> Having recorded the [[The Paths of Heaven|Paths of Heaven]] from the bottom of [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]], Lindon possesses black-and-white [[Dreadgod]] eyes that burn inhumanly and a [[scale]] that can dissolve.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c7">''Waybound'', chapter 7</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Having consumed substances that could have destroyed his soul, Lindon experienced a twitching in his right arm while using a quill and notebook to record notes.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c7" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c8">''Waybound'', chapter 8</ref> While hovering over [[Sacred Valley]], the weight of a [[dragon]]'s charge felt as heavy as a physical blow from a [[Dreadgod]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c9">''Waybound'', chapter 9</ref> Lindon prepared diets for [[Little Blue]] and [[Orthos]], the latter of whom he kept memories for, while also keeping the [[Black dragon Remnants|black dragon Remnants]] locked away.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c10">''Waybound'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c12">''Waybound'', chapter 12</ref> Possessing the power of the [[Void Icon]], Lindon traded techniques with [[Northstrider]] during their battle.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c10" /> While concentrating [[madra]] in his left hand and using [[Northstrider]]'s [[Icon]], Lindon stretched his perception far to the north.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c11">''Waybound'', chapter 11</ref> After besting [[Northstrider]], [[Lindon's body]] was ravaged and his will strained as he fought a battle against [[Monarchs]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c12" /> Lindon emerged from the [[Trackless Sea]] in a weak and potentially dead state, as [[Little Blue]] was not yet strong enough to assist him.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c13">''Waybound'', chapter 13</ref> Despite his condition, Lindon's sheer stubbornness allowed him === {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Fighting the Weeping Dragon}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|During his battle against the [[Weeping Dragon]], Lindon fought alongside [[Orthos]] and [[Little Blue]] while facing a claw large enough to scoop out entire villages.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18">''Waybound'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19">''Waybound'', chapter 19</ref> After gripping a handful of [[scales]] to begin consuming, Lindon utilized his [[madra channels]] and deep cores to weaken the [[Dreadgod]]'s blow with an [[Empty Palm]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /> The [[Soulsmith]] who assembled the [[Penance arrow]] struck the [[dragon]]'s belly with breath before dropping his bow and losing all power and [[aura]] control.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /> As he fell from the sky like a vanishing candle-flame, Lindon appeared as a dense core of black-and-[[white power]] beneath the [[dragon]]'s head and forced its breath into the sky.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /> Having provided a chance for [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]], [[Mercy]], and [[Yerin]], Lindon was left with empty cores and a weak presence.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20">''Waybound'', chapter 20</ref> The crafter of the [[Ancient Bow of the Soulseeker|Silent King Bow]] and its arrows used prototype [[Penance arrowheads]] to create three new arrows, though he was ultimately needed to repair the [[Grand Oath Array]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" /> On the verge of death during the fight, Lindon consumed something from the [[Dreadgod]]'s corpse, an act that allowed him to eventually defend his [[labyrinth]] against multiple [[Monarchs]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21">''Waybound'', chapter 21</ref> While considering using [[Soulsmithing]] to remove damage, Lindon dealt with a right arm of white flesh being transformed by [[Dreadgod]] essence and summoned [[Wavedancer]] from his [[void key]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" /> As Ozriel hoped to see him ascend, Lindon restored the house using the [[Void Icon]] and continued to take more [[Dreadgod power]], leading [[Northstrider]] to refer to him as [[Ghost]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c22">''Waybound'', chapter 22</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23">''Waybound'', chapter 23</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|While searching for [[Emriss Silentborn]], the black-and-white eyed Lindon, who carries [[Dross]], possesses more [[Authority|authority]] over [[hunger]] than anyone due to the [[Path of the Hungry Deep]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23" /> Known as the [[Empty Ghost]] and current owner of his world, Lindon prepared to fight [[Northstrider]] by performing a summoning in [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]] with the intent to [[Consume]] the [[Monarch]] upon his arrival.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24">''Waybound'', chapter 24</ref> Having already Consumed the [[Dreadgods]], he carries the arm of the [[Slumbering Wraith]] in his hand and is willing to use force against [[Northstrider]] if persuasion fails, though his worst-case scenario involves killing the [[Monarch]] himself.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24" /> As he attempts to enter the [[The Book of Eternal Night|Book of Eternal Night]], [[Lindon's body]] exists as a projection of his mind and [[spirit]], fueled by mostly stolen power that is sufficient to shake the fabric of the world.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c25">''Waybound'', chapter 25</ref> Despite never figuring out how to fully repair the Array, Lindon has reached the level of [[Monarch]] in less than a decade, and his [[Shadow|shadow]] looms in the futures [[Malice]] sees.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26">''Waybound'', chapter 26</ref> During a battle involving two [[Dreadgods]] and a meteor condensed from [[earth aura]], Lindon used [[Wavedancer]] to deflect a [[Striker technique]] and met [[Reigan Shen]]'s pounce with a [[Soul Cloak]]-powered punch.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27">''Waybound'', chapter 27</ref> Having taken up most of the [[Monarch]]'s attention in previous fights with [[Malice]], Lindon felt [[Yerin]] advance and realized he would have to watch out for her if she joined the fight.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c28">''Waybound'', chapter 28</ref> Capable of stealing memories, Lindon consumed a spear from the [[Bleeding Phoenix]] during a battle involving [[The Phoenix|the Phoenix]] and launched [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]] at the [[Wandering Titan]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c29">''Waybound'', chapter 29</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30">''Waybound'', chapter 30</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|While in [[Cradle]], Lindon harassed the [[Titan]] with [[Blackflame]] and commanded the workers near [[The Phoenix|the Phoenix]]'s talon to break while waiting for an unknown event.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c31">''Waybound'', chapter 31</ref> His connection to the [[Void Icon]] caused him to feel chaos and absence, leaving him with too much of a connection to [[hunger]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c31" /> The [[Sage of Twin Stars]] can release a trickle of his [[spirit-sense|spiritual sense]], control [[Wind aura|wind aura]] over a [[courtyard]], and must act within limited time.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c32">''Waybound'', chapter 32</ref> Using [[pure madra]] and the [[Authority|authority]] of the [[Void Icon]], Lindon constructed a meeting space where he pulled weapons from his [[soulspace]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c33">''Waybound'', chapter 33</ref> After opening the [[Soulforge]] in [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]] depths, Lindon utilized the weapon [[Genesis]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c34">''Waybound'', chapter 34</ref> Known as Wei Shi Lindon, he can unleash power that solidifies the air and proposed a point-based game in the arena.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c35">''Waybound'', chapter 35</ref> During combat, Lindon used [[Storm madra|storm madra]] to blast against [[Li Markuth|Markuth]]'s attack and punched through his defenses with his right hand.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c35" /> Clad in armor made from [[Dreadgods]] and a cloak of boiling liquid [[blood]], he summoned a blue-gold lightning [[flying sword]] to join nine other swords in formation.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c35" /> As his right hand fingers twitched like they were possessed by spirits, Lindon tore open a rift in [[Way|the Way]] and marched into a tenuous [[portal]] to ascend from [[Cradle]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c35" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c36">''Waybound'', chapter 36</ref> His heart lifted as he asked if they were heading to [[Judge Suriel|Suriel]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c36" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|After emerging from a [[Way-portal]] alongside [[Yerin]], Lindon became aware of warnings issued by the [[Abidan]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c13">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 13</ref> He demonstrated the ability to push himself through space and utilized his [[Wind aura|wind aura]] to create a zone of silence around himself and [[Yerin]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c13" /> While extending his [[spirit-sense|spiritual sense]], Lindon also employed [[Blackflame]] to burn off a man's beard.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c13" /><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c14">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 14</ref>}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|“Wei Shi Lindon,” the First Elder intones, as Lindon moves forward.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c1" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|“This one was in search of an ancestral fruit, on behalf of his mother.”<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|“One strike each, if it pleases you. First, you take one strike from this one without defense or resistance. Then you strike me in turn. The first to lose his footing is defeated.”<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c5" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|“Today, I’ve shown that my ability reaches beyond my level of advancement.”<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c6" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|“I’m pleased to have descended personally, Wei Shi Lindon.”<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c11" />}}
